V01.text_zh: 林間空地上,一隻腿部受傷的鹿望著你們,眼神溫馴。牠身邊有個旅人遺落的背囊。
V01.text_en: In a clearing, a deer with an injured leg watches you with gentle eyes. Beside it lies a traveler's lost pack.

options.zh: 治療牠的傷口(全隊回復 8 點 HP)

V02.text_zh: 一位蒙面工匠在樹樁上攤開工具:「讓我看看你的骰子……我可以免費為它添一點『趣味』。」
V02.text_en: A masked artisan spreads tools on a stump: 'Show me a die... I can add a little spice, free of charge.'

options.zh: 選一個骰面附魔(隨機關鍵字)

V03.text_zh: 狐狸攤主搖著骰盅:「30 金幣一注,擲出 4、5、6 就贏 60 金幣,擲出 1、2、3 就全部輸掉。要玩嗎?」
V03.text_en: A fox rattles a dice cup: '30 gold a bet. Roll 4-6, win 60. Roll 1-3, lose it all. Care to play?'

V04.text_zh: 苔蘚覆蓋的古老祭壇滲出微光,上面刻著:「以血為祭,以寶為酬。」
V04.text_en: An ancient moss-covered altar glows faintly. The carving reads: 'Blood for tribute, treasure for reward.'

options.zh: 犧牲全隊各 4 點 HP,獲得一件普通遺物
options.en: Sacrifice 4 HP from each hero for a Common relic

V05.text_zh: 一隻小小的妖精拉著你的斗篷:「我迷路了……送我回家,我的家人會重重有賞!」
V05.text_en: A tiny imp tugs your cloak: 'I'm lost... take me home and my family will reward you handsomely!'

options.zh: 護送牠(下場戰鬥敵人 +1,勝利可得額外遺物)
options.en: Escort it (next battle +1 enemy, bonus relic on win)

V06.text_zh: 前路被一片冒泡的毒沼攔住。直行可以省時,但毒氣會滲入皮膚;繞路則要多走很遠。
V06.text_en: A bubbling toxic marsh blocks the path. Wading through is fast but the fumes seep in; going around takes far longer.

options.zh: 涉水直行(下場戰鬥全隊開局中毒 2 層)
options.en: Wade through (party starts next battle with Poison 2)
Go around (skip the next row of nodes)

V07.text_zh: 廢棄的訓練場仍留著一個木人樁,還有一位隱居的老教頭願意指點一二。
V07.text_en: An abandoned training ground with a battered dummy. A retired drillmaster offers a quick lesson.

options.zh: 休整(全隊回復 10% 最大 HP)

V08.text_zh: 清澈的泉水閃著虹光。傳說將骰面浸入泉中,會蛻變成更珍稀的型態——但沒有人知道會變成什麼。
V08.text_en: A spring shimmers with prismatic light. They say a die face dipped here transforms into something rarer — though none can say what.

options.zh: 浸泡一個骰面(重鑄成高一級稀有度的隨機骰面)
options.en: Dip a face (reforge into a random face of higher rarity)

V09.text_zh: 一隊騾車商隊停在路邊,貨箱大開,琳瑯滿目:「路過的朋友,全部七折!」
V09.text_en: A mule caravan rests by the road, crates open and gleaming: 'For travelers only — everything 30% off!'

V10.text_zh: 千年古樹的樹洞滲出溫暖金光,樹靈的聲音在你們腦海中響起:「選一位,受我祝福。」
V10.text_en: Warm golden light pours from the hollow of an ancient tree. A voice echoes: 'Choose one to receive my blessing.'

options.zh: 一位英雄最大 HP +4 並回復滿
options.en: One hero gains +4 max HP and fully heals

options.zh: 全隊回復 15% 最大 HP

V11.text_zh: 一個黑影手腳俐落地搶走你的錢袋,朝密林深處逃去!
V11.text_en: A shadowy figure snatches your coin purse and darts into the thicket!

options.zh: 追捕(立即進入精英戰,勝利可得普通遺物 +40 金幣)
options.en: Give chase (elite battle now; win a Common relic +40 gold)

V12.text_zh: 一座半明半暗的古老神像。光明的一面莊嚴肅穆,黑暗的一面深邃誘人。你感覺到兩股力量正在等你選擇。
V12.text_en: An ancient idol, half light, half shadow. Both faces hum with power, waiting for your choice.

options.zh: 光明面(本次冒險攻擊面全部 +1,全隊最大 HP -3)
options.en: Light face (all attack faces +1 this run, party max HP -3)

options.zh: 黑暗面(全隊最大 HP +6,金幣獎勵 -20%)
options.en: Dark face (party max HP +6, gold rewards -20%)
